text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The number of collaborators for the Grand 
Live drastically increased. Among them was 
an Umamusume who was once against the 
idea... She, too, had feelings she wanted 
to convey to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A grand stage capable of holding over a 
hundred thousand people. The path to 
making it a reality was finally coming 
into view.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, word arrives from the URA. At 
long last, the Grand Live has been 
officially approved! With the performance 
secured, preparations continue full steam 
ahead.
